data.gender_notes: Kanmani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Goddess of Love and Beauty in Hindu mythology. She is often depicted with a garland of flowers and is associated with the god Murugan. The name Kanmani carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Beauty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil. Parents who choose Kanmani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine feminine and the power of love and beauty in the universe.
data.etymology: Kanmani belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love and Beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kanmani total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
